title: I Built an AI Financial Operating System for Business #shorts #finance #automation
description:
In this video, I break down a Claude AI financial operating system that works in the background of my business, running seven different agents connected into Gmail and QuickBooks.

This system starts by monitoring your inbox daily — the moment somebody reaches out about a proposal or contract, it marks it and routes it to the right place. When a contract actually gets signed, the next agent pulls the client, amount, and payment schedule straight out of that email, sets up the customer in QuickBooks, and drafts the invoice into an email for you — but nothing ever goes out until you've looked at it, you're always the one hitting send. If payment doesn't come in on time, it follows up on its own with a friendly reminder, then a firmer one, and flags it straight to you after two weeks if it's still unpaid. It's also watching the money going out, sorting every bank and card transaction into the right category automatically, and forecasting your cash position 30, 60, and 90 days out. And every week, it sends you one summary — cash flow, expenses, income, who hasn't paid you — so you can be anywhere in the world and know exactly where you're at.

This doesn't replace an accountant — it just handles the repetitive admin for you before you're ready to hire a full finance team in-house.

This is for business owners who don't have a full finance or accounting team, and anyone who wants to understand how a Claude AI system can be used to run the financial side of a business — email, invoicing, collections, expenses, and reporting all in one place.

If you are interested in using Claude, AI automation, or building a system like this for your business, this video shows the full concept.
